text: Great food, but the staff lost my luggage and I had to wait for two days to get it back.
Honestly, I wasn’t expecting much, but the airline surprised me with great service and on-time arrival. I might fly with them again"
I almost missed my connecting flight due to a delay, but the staff went out of their way to help me. Very impressed!
Despite the turbulence and some noise, the crew handled everything professionally, making me feel safe throughout
Oh sure, they ‘upgraded’ me to a seat right next to the restroom. What a luxury!
Great announcements throughout the flight, if you ignore the fact that the plane was late by 3 hours.
I appreciated the free snacks, even though the overall service left a lot to be desired.
The crew smiled a lot, which was the only good part of the trip.
The airplane looked clean on the outside, but the cabin was dirty and uncomfortable.
I was annoyed at first by the delay, but the captain’s explanations were honest and reassuring.

The plane itself was very modern and the in-flight entertainment system was excellent. Unfortunately, the experience was ruined by constant delays and a very bumpy ride that made it difficult to relax. Despite the amenities, I wouldn’t say this was a pleasant trip.

The pilot gave frequent updates and reassured us throughout the flight, which I appreciated. But the turbulence was so severe that many passengers, including myself, were visibly shaken and uneasy. Despite the pilot’s efforts, the flight was quite stressful overall.

The staff smiled and greeted us warmly at boarding, setting a nice tone initially. However, as the flight progressed, their service became inconsistent and slow, which was disappointing given the good start.

I initially booked two separate flights for this airline in November. The first was a LHR-SIN-LHR flight and another was a SIN-MNL-SIN flight. To cut the story short, I requested to rebook my LHR-SIN flight two weeks ahead of my scheduled flight due to a family bereavement and I needed to be in the Philippines. Despite my personal situation, I received an amazing support from the Customer Service team, who happily reorganised my flight, connected my 2 flight bookings so I can get to Manila on time, and without rebooking fees. At the London airport, I was sent-off warmly by the ground staff who has empathised with me as I check-in and ensure I was boarded comfortably in the plane. These gestures of goodwill and support made me grateful for Singapore Airlines. Even though I am no longer based in Singapore, I will always find a way to fly with them. Thank you. These words are never enough for the outstanding, grateful and sincere help you have provided me.

I flew on SQ217 from Singapore to Melbourne on the 4th of January. My flight was terrible. To begin with my seat was broken and couldn’t be moved and the entertainment device was broken as well. My flight of nearly 8 hours was spent looking blankly into space, seated in the same position. I had severe back pain upon arrival as a result for the next couple of days. When I informed the crew, first the steward said I will be compensated with a voucher and asked me to choose what I like from the duty free catalog. When I did choose a product that would be useful for me, I was told by the air hostess that my voucher is only for $75 Singapore dollars and the rest will have to be paid by me! I informed them I don’t need their $75 voucher and that I will make a formal complaint about the plane’s defects. After my return I did make the complaint and they got back to me saying that another travel voucher of AU$200 will be issued to be used in my next flight with Singapore airlines. But the worst part was they lied and said I was offered another seat but I had declined saying I wanted to be seated next to my husband. This was an outrageous lie. At no point did they offer me another seat. This is very concerning. I would urge everyone flying in SQ next time, to either video any exchange with the crew in situations like this or get it in writing. After discussing with my husband, I informed them that I would not be flying with them in the near future so they can give me a cash voucher. But they replied saying they can only give me a voucher to be used for my future bookings through Singapore airlines. I refused to accept it because I will not fly with them in the future. Even a budget airline would have been more comfortable than this flight. But the greatest worry is their dishonesty.

Checkin and immigration entry at Changi Airport a breeze, all completed and straight to Business Lounge within 5-10 minutes, Lovely and comfortable lounge at T3 with a vast array of food and beverages. Flight left slightly late due to operational issues but pre flight champagne was served and we were then on our way. I elected to have a meal upon departure ( as this was a 1am flight, but you can elect to have served 2 hours prior to arrival) and was served a very tasty steak and vegetables with some lovely french red wine. Staff then prepared lie down bed for a sleep which was bliss after a long day. Staff very courteous and professional as always , a reasonwhy I will continue to use SQ for all travel given the brilliant experience with this great airline, everytime.

Waiting patiently for a family from USA in front of me while going through easyJet boarding control, that's the scenario. EasyJet made a mistake for the family from USA and all 4 of the crew where involved, so I just held back patiently. Once the USA family were through I was asked are you going to Spain, when I said yes she just spoke to me as if I was a naughty boy at school! The attitude she gave me was not necessary. She became more stroppy till the point I had to tell her to stop talking to me that way, and said it would have be nicer to greet me and say sorry for the delay have you your boarding pass? Not impressed and that's not the first time this kind of attitude has been experienced. The cabin crew on the plane were all very nice, so makes no sense why she was absolutely bitter angry! Hope someone looks into this, you have my flight number.

When returning home from Amsterdam to Birmingham our flight was delayed over 3 hours. The first issue we encountered was there was no easyjet representative to advise there was any delay, only the boards so we had no idea why there was a delay. We then received an email stating there was a delay and we would recieve a SMS message shortly with a voucher for £6 to use for food or drink. This never came through, which was disappointing as we didn't expect any kind of voucher but was advised we would, which never happened. We then boarded the plane for the pilot to advise that there was a delay due to a technical issue with the original plane, so an alternative plane was flown from Gatwick to Birmingham, to then fly from Birmingham to get us from Amsterdam. We submitted a compensation form as it states online that a delay over 3 hours can result with compensation in vouchers (money back). We then recieved a response to the email stating there will be no compensation as it was down to weather conditions which is under extraordinary circumstances. If we had recieved an email stating there was no comepnsation due to the actual reason of a technical fault with the plane we would have accepted it, as we have never had to claim on an airline before. The fact that we have been blatantly lied to twice, first with the voucher and then with the reason of the delay (due to weather) is extremely unprofessional and dishonest.

Terrible service, flights and boarding are always late and the luggage minimum size is clearly a method to spill extra money out of their costumers. In addition the luggage they forced me to board was damaged. Last time I will ever travel with this scammers company.

Went to Spain on the 5/6/2025 for 2weeks Bristol delayed then instead of reus airport went to Barcelona no reps at airport had to ask jet2 rep Ware easy jet rep was found a man with a clip board he told us we had to wait 45 minutes for a Coach hour and half to hotel no reps at all for the 2 Weeks had a email last day pick up 2 45 am pick up driver drop us at wrong terminal 20 minutes walk hour and half waiting for deparcher to open we will never travel with easyJet again even I they offered us a free holiday

We have flown with Easyjet in the past and have always found them to be OK. The flights used to feel like you were on a budget airline and the flights we have taken sometimes had delays. However, it had been a number a years since our last Easyjet flight, until our holiday this year. This time we were impressed! It felt like we were travelling with a completely different airline company. The baggage was quick and easy to check-in both on departure and return. Both flights left exactly on time too. All the staff were really nice and even the food we had on board was of a very good standard. Honestly, this was one of the best flying experiences we have had for some time. We will be booking again. Thank you.

We were hesitating on booking our flight with EasyJet because of the bad reviews, but then again it had a lot of good reviews too. We decided to book with them and honestly, for a short 2h flight, our experience was great! Takeoff was good, barely any turbulence, landing was good too. For the baggages, we received them with little new scratches but other than that it went pretty fast and we received our luggage’s fast too! Seats are like any economy class seats, maybe a little less comfortable but I didn’t mind. All in all, pretty good experience! Thank you EasyJet :)

One of the best customer services I've ever experienced in my life. Traveling with my 75 yo mom and my 76 yo father who's got Alzheimer's, the entire crew was extremely supportive during the entire flight, and even offered me a shoulder to cry on, after I was finally able to help my mom take my father inside the bathroom and broke into tears. With so much emotional pressure, unfortunately, I didn't get the attendants' names (TP94 on March 13th, 2025, at 11:50 pm), but I'll never forget this experience and I'll always treasure and share it with everyone. From the botton of my heart, thank you, TAP team.
This was my 2nd tap experience. Wrote a terrible review in November on a Toronto to Funchal round trip. This was a short one and want to report that all went smoothly. So not all experiences are bad😎

I've flown TAP a few times now. Long hauls from SFO to LIS, then shorter routes within Europe as well. Every time, quality and service have been top notch. And the value is incredible! Also omg the food... I'm vegetarian, and have had some awful vegetarian meals on planes. The TAP food is tasty and fresh! Great offering. TAP has enabled me to explore the world in a way I never anticipated, thanks TAP team!!!

I have flown many times with TAP, both within Europe and on long-haul flights to Africa and South America. They have always been a decent airline in terms of timeliness and quality of service. However, it is when you need to make changes or if there are cancellations that you really see whether an airline respects its customers and is honest. Where other airlines (Turkish Airlines, TAAG Angola, Delta to name a few) might abuse customers or make it near impossible to claim benefits or get a reimbursement, TAP are very clear and smart on this aspect. I had to cancel my flight from Zurich to Luanda (via Lisbon) as my ticket allowed, and it was super easy to get my money back. Logging into my account and with only a few clicks, no need to call or present any justifications, TAP accepted my reimbursement request and I had the money back on my account within just a few days. I realise this is how it should be, but it is rare enough that an airline is honest and decent, I thought I would mention it. This makes TAP one of the few airlines that I actually trust.
Read many negative reviews so was worried but I am writing this review to say my experience was really good, staff were excellent on the flight and no delays/cancellations, I would recommend TAP
The best airline I've ever traveled is this the crew was nice the food was excellent and the in-flight entertainment was amazing this airline deserves 5 star

While coming back I had reaction to meds the pilot and all the staff took good care of me and my family they put us up in a nice hotel and paid for everything we are very greatful to quatar airways and all their staff quatar airways gets 5 stars from me

Name change due to oversight when booked, only noticed when on-line checkin commenced . Worried I won't be able to go quickly contacted customer care and they assisted and went the extra mile and assisted at a very distressful time. They were professional and extremely sympathetic. True customer care at its best... Thankyou Qatar Airways.

I took Qatar Airways for the first time recently for a business trip. It was a 23+ hour trip so I upgraded myself to business class! It wasn’t cheap but still less expensive than upgrading on a U.S. carrier. Oh MY God!!! It was amazing and beats any other domestic carrier’s first class.. Not kidding.. incredible service, as in, they serve you whatever is on the extensive high end menu, whenever you want it… really good food and wine selections. Then if you’re taking the night flight like I was, they make up your lie flat bed for you and supply pajamas and an amenity bag that is equipped with all of the necessities for a good nights sleep on a plane, along with high end hand cream, etc. To say that it is the ultimate experience is an understatement. I won’t fly anything else if I can Qatar and why would I… it’s simply the best! Ps.. It just happened to be my birthday during one of the legs and somehow they knew and gave me a birthday treat with a Happy Birthday light up sign.. I mean, COME ON!! LOVE QATAR AIRWAYS and they’re genuinely friendly and accommodating staff!

In all my Europe trips, I only choose Qatar Airways, because I go for comfort and convenience. Something that is based from my experience in almost 2 decades of flying with QR. As a long time member of their Frequent Flyer, QR’s economy is comfortable and the food and drink selections are great. Plus I am happy with the service, baggage handling and the airport of Qatar in Doha.

I'd like to thank the entire flight crew for making my flight such a comfortable and welcoming experience. I have used several airlines in the past, and Qatar definitely gets a first-class feeling although you're only travelling in Economy class. Nothing is too much for the attendants and that really is something that is rare these days. Thank you especially to the team manager, Mahmudhur Rahman. I'm quite sure with a good manager a good team ensues. Many thanks!

Thank you so much. It was best flight I ever had. It was delayed 20 minutes, but during the flight they gave us so many snacks and drinks. I felt myself again at granny's. I used so many airlines before, but never ever had such plenty of food and comfortable flight. Also there i charged all my devices, watched films and shows in different languages, there was no queue to toilet. Toilet was large enough to feel myself comfortable. They delivered us blankets and pillows even without request. Crew always smiled and was the best I ever saw. Thank you guys. And I know that it is not actually low cost airlines, but tickets were not expensive at all

Melbourne Doha - the Irish guy in the window seat alongside our 2 seats had at least 10 scotch and cokes before he fell asleep. That didn't stop him singing in his sleep. The staff were very attentive and simply don't say - "you've had enough". That has it's good and not so good points. Some people can't control themselves when given free alcohol. Comfy seats, good selection of movies and Starlink gave us internet access on both Melbourne/Doha and return. The staff were friendly and seriously look after passengers. The moment we stopped people were opening overhead lockers well before the seat belt sign went off and again - the customer is right was on full display. Food was ok. From Doha we flew to Prague with Qatar - this time opposite us there was a gent who decided he just wanted to drink scotch. Finally after multiple requests for refills with the passenger holding the hostesses arm she just poured what was left from the bottle into his glass. When he slept with his head on the tray table they left him even during landing. He was obnoxious and out of it. After 3 weeks in Europe we flew Budapest to Doha with a 22 hour stopover. The airline retained our luggage and checked it through in Budapest for our Doha Melbourne return journey. Needless to say i expected to never see our bags again but sure enough they were on our flight so the Qatar system is obviously robust and efficient. Very tolerant staff who have to deal with some really bad passengers.

Their service is top tier, the flight is clean, seats are comfortable and have sufficient leg room. Their in- flight entertainment had varieties and was for free. The pilot made me feel @ease when we where passing through turbulence. I was given a special diet meal by marry ann on flight QR1378 from SA to Doha, Date 18/05/2025 although my travel agent failed to inform Qatar of my nut allergy. Cabin Crews are all friendly and welcoming. Asma made me feel like the only passenger on flight QR183. It was my birthday on the 19/05/2025 and she came to my seat and said happy birthday and gave me a gift. I'm still humbled by the experience. overall service was excellent. On 25/05/2025 flight QR292 from Prague, the weather was too cold cabin crew gave me an extra blanket, Ivarn the supervisor gave me special diet meal because of my allergies and she informed me that in the future, I must notify the airline 7 days in advance. I felt considered and I will definitely use their services in the future and I will definitely recommend them to others.

I have travelled the world all my life for both business and pleasure, lived and worked in more than 100 countries, 34 +flights on Concord and mostly first, business and economy on way too many airlines. I am a life time gold card member with BA but never fly long haul with them now as they do not operate out of PER. Qatar airways are simply in a league of their own totally exceptional in every way . The business class, in particular their amazing wines are outstanding, the crews and total customer support brilliant . They are unbeatable in every way and I will never fly with anyone else and complete 6+ trips a year every year with them mainly to LHR and my home in NCE. Heaven at 40,000 feet Karl E Watkin MBE

Absolutely fabulous airline. From online check-in, to extremely helpful customer service at physical check-in on departure (thank you) to the flight/s with all in-flight needs well catered for. Cannot fault this airline - based on our recent experience.

Mr Mahyu (flight attendant) was extremely excellent in kindness and hospitality, the way he was attending all the pessangers in flight is incredable. He gave a very special respect to every pessenger that is really Appriciable. My Honarable thanks to Mr Mahyu for his Great behaviour full of respect and kindness. And i always pray that when ever i travel in emirates Mr Mahyu will be with us.

Just want to share the experience in flying this Emirates flight. Flew with my family and all was well and smooth. On time flight, clean, good food, exceptional entertainment! Then I dropped my phone!! Could not find it the whole flight!! A Miss Eva or Era really helped me a lot!! Sorry I could not remember the name. She is a big asset to Emirates as she helped me find it, then made good recommendations. Found my phone and was relieved! But the ones who found it was the cleaners and ground staffs! Thank you again and will fly with you more in the future. Best regards, Glenn

I recently flew with Emirates from Manchester to Dubai, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. Check-in was smooth, and the staff were professional and welcoming. The cabin was clean, spacious, and very comfortable, with plenty of legroom. The in-flight entertainment had a great selection of movies and shows, and the food was tasty and well-presented. The crew were outstanding — friendly, attentive, and always ready to help. A truly five-star airline. Looking forward to flying with Emirates again :)
Awesome airline and staff was very friendly. Food quality is same the other airlines. But seats are very comfortable. It was 17 hour flight but didn’t feel a long journey.

I misssed my connecting to Shanghai, plane disembarked very slow, hense the reason i missed my connecting flight. Groung staff we exceptional in assisting me to connect the next flight to Shanghai. However it was almost 14hours. Emirates being totally commited to they passengers , organised hotel , visa and transfers for the lay over. Because i already a single entry visa , i could not get another visa. Emirates staff had the option of allowing me to stay in the Dubai airport hotel so that i would not have any problems when i came back from Shanghai to visit Dubai. This is why Emirates are world leaders in travel and offering the best pricing and service. I would.recommend anyone who wishes.to travel to any any part of the world , Fly with Emirates the experience in flight and on the ground is phenomenal This is more than 5 star Compliments to your staff and Emirates. My airline of choice Mr Laher

It was great experiance , my coach seat was good especially I am tall. And the food was good & one more important thing is that the restroom was clean. The flight attendances that served me were very sweet and helpful. I was really surprised.

Boarded Flight EK 226 front San francisco to Dubai on 11th June. In Premium economy. We both were flying Emirates after a long time as the timing of flight from Mumbai to Dubai is very odd 4.30 in morning. We jad Emily as our Attendent. She was very attentive and served with a smile. My wife had some specific request for food, and Emily very kindly obliged. Incidentally We know that She is Irish ! She extended same service to all others in our cabin. We shall try and choose Emirates , just for getting such a good attendant, let me say, a friend in the skies !! ( this site asking me to choose from Economy/ Business/ First class. We flew in Premium Economy... that option is not given, So I am ticking Economy)

My flight went really well while being affordable. I flew on the 09th of June on the night flight at 21:00 from BLR to DXB. I wanted to specially mention a flight attendant Anasteisha as she was extremely friendly and attentive making sure to remember even the smallest details making my experience extremely positive.

Great service and with more room in economy than most airlines. Another important point that differentiates the airline from others are its employees. Special thanks to Abderrahim from Guest Services at DXB Airport and Katia Elias from the Sao Paulo office. Great service, would be great if the airline always kept on hiring employees like them.

"So, I'm writing a review for Aya6165804. She's the best air hostess I've ever seen. She knows very well how to deal with passengers, and her confidence is wow! I also think she's sweet. I really like her and how she performs her duties with a beautiful smile and dedication."

Flight from dxb to ncl 16/5/2025. Excellent flight , from comfort to in flight service. Big shout out to Joanne Fergus on (supervisor) for running such a tight ship and delivering the best service. I myself being an ex cabin crew, can appreciate all the hard work the crew carry out. 10 out of 10 will be flying with you again. Please pass on to Joanne. Thank you Patricia Egozi

I would like to highlight amazing people that we're helping us through our journey. Nilisha, Imane, Konica, Elisa, Danielle and additional thanks to Maria and Sonal. Great teamwork! Nilisha was outstanding handling alot of requests like a pro! Konica I have no words to describe your caring and finding my baby's bracelet. Thank you from the bottom of my heart! Elisa thank you for helping with bags. I appreciate you all and those who helped me and assisted you made my day travelling with newborn to be like a good day! You ALL deserve 🌟 STARS! I wish you all to always share this warthm and happiness you all made us feel like home! All the best, Love and respect! From other mother's that you ALL have assisted that day wanted to thank you all. The plain felt like a kindergarden with all the little once on the plane. It was not easy at all, but you all made it GREAT! Thank you to staff and pilots who made our journey good and silky!

Good food, good service. The meals were well-prepared, the onboard entertainment had a large library of movies. Just a few sick passengers that were coughing a lot .. I got sick shortly after my journey.

Emirates has improved its whole experience from London Stansted. There is now a dedicated lounge, which has all the usual Emirates facilities and you board direct from the lounge which is a major improvement. Please be aware that you should do any shopping before getting on the train to the gate as there is no return. Our outbound flight was on the old B777 interior, however we returned on the brand new retrofitted B777 from Dubai, this cabin is a major improvement in a 1-2-1 configuration, like the A380 we had for longer flights from Dubai. The new cabin feels quality and very up to date. The service was excellent, food and drink all top quality and served by courteous crew. On arrival at Stansted after the short train trip back to the terminal we were through the dedicated fast track immigration and a luggage carousel at which we didn't have to wait more than five minutes for our luggage. Then out to arrivals to find our chauffeur waiting. All in all a great experience and I am pleased Emirates have their own lounge as the Escape lounge was dire. Living in East Anglia this award winning airline at Stansted is a bonus.

We travelled Business Class on a recent holiday to Dubai (including return leg). This was the first time we had travelled Business Class with Emirates and was very impressed with the whole experience. We have travelled Business as a family before using British Airways, but the Emirates experience is a level above in my opinion. Seats were really comfortable, plenty of room and really liked the idea of your own mini bar with your seat. They added extra little touches, such as providing a mattress and all in all, we really enjoyed the service. The only slight criticism I would have is that the food served wasn't brilliant and I think if this could be improved, then would have to put Emirates right near the top of the Business Class service amongst the airlines. Would definitely look to fly Business Class again with Emirates

By far the best flight we’ve had. The Emirates Lounge was huge with many choices for food and drinks. Seating was very comfortable with plenty different types of seating. Even with a longer layover, we were able to spend the entire time at the lounge. The plane was clean and comfortable and the staff were awesome. Very friendly, attentive and professional. Business Class seats were roomy with lay flat options. Entertainment had several choices with wifi available after takeoff. Food on the plane was served hot and tasty. I can’t say enough about the flight team. They were by far the most pleasant team we’ve ever experienced. I definitely recommend this airline.

I just wanted to give a huge thank you to Jose Lopes from the economy cabin crew team. He was incredibly kind, professional, and attentive, not just to me but to everyone around. He made the flight experience so much more comfortable and pleasant. Jose truly went above and beyond, and I really hope he gets recognized and rewarded for his outstanding service. He’s a star!
this is an amazing airline the service is exceptional!!!! im coming from norse where the flight service was terrible thanks so much emirates!!!!!

As always emirates lives up to the expectations of fly better, from the seamless online check-in to the baggage claim the things went on smooth without any haste. especially when you are traveling with toddler emirates is the best, they give some goodies to the baby and keep on checking if everything is fine, in this flight our baby was sick and had vomited in the cabin, but the crew give us ample tissues and a bag to change the baby's cloths and regularly checked on us and prioritizing our meal service as well, this Suttle care makes the difference between a good and a great airline.

Wonderful flight with Emirates. Boarding was a little chaotic at Bangkok, so many people wanting to get on the A380 at the same time. We departed on time, luckily just a few hours prior to the Bangkok earthquake on March 28, 2025. Service onboard was exceptional. Would like to especially thank a cabin crew member - Layla from South Africa. Her service was amazing. Professional yet friendly & welcoming. Food & beverages provided were excellent. Economy class seats were comfortable with plenty of leg room in our exit row. Inflight entertainment is the best we have ever experienced. So many options. Well done Emirates.

The flights were on time, checking in was quick, the Emirates lounges very comfortable with a good selection of food and drinks.The service provided by the flight attendants was friendly and attentive. The bathrooms always spotless. The lounge area aboard is a bonus. The limo transfers at each end of the flight were appreciated. My new preferred airline.

We flew Premium Economy Brussels - Dubai and Dubai - Brisbane. We've flown with Emirates in Economy to Europe before and found the service and flight very good but weren't able to sleep much. We had the opportunity to upgrade to Premium Economy this time and hoped we'd get a little more sleep, plus of course all the other advertised benefits of Emirates PE. Where we normally manage to get perhaps a short nap on flights, this time we got some solid sleep - hooray! The seats were much, much, much more comfortable than Economy. Between the extra recline, calf rest and footrest you can find a position that's comfortable much more easily than Economy and having the tray table in the armrest helps when the person in front reclines as it doesn't move your table. The food was as expected - delicious, generous, and the plates really made a difference. What we hadn't expected though was the extra attention from the flight attendants. We've never had a complaint about service in Economy with Emirates, but PE service was amazing.

Right, let’s give emirates a big W and also a round of applause for their wonderful server from DxB-KHI, The flight attendants were very caring and also being polite, The flight time was about 2 hours. I’d tell my friends to book on emirates as their in-flight service (ICE/Food & Beverage) is excellent, this airline deserve to be 5 starred. Thanks emirates!

Paula (Air Hostress) service towards us was absolutely fantastic. We travelled as we had a bereavement she made our journey so much easier and smoother. She showed empathy towards us and treated us incredibly. She is an asset to Emirates and wish her all the best in her career.
The air hostess Soomin. Amazing. Great smile. Genuine and good hearted service. I have been flying past 42 years. I never ever seen like her. It is a very difficult job. She is very smart and polite.

Booked full holiday through Emirates and would highly recommend. The flights, transfers and resort all top class. I will definitely book another holiday through Emirates. And if recommend the Emirates lounge at the airport. Great way to start your holiday 😊

For 27 years, our family has flown Emirates, consistently enjoying the pleasant crew, comfortable seats, good food, great entertainment, and reliable WiFi. We cherish the memories of thoughtful touches like hot towels, vanity bags, and toy bags for kids, which once set Emirates apart. While we appreciate business class, we believe every passenger deserves respect and exceptional service, regardless of class. A wonderful gesture would be to occasionally offer economy passengers a chance to experience business or first class, or allow them to use premium check-in counters when available. Thank you, Emirates team, for 27 years of amazing flying experiences in Dubai.
We flew out to Dubai on the 1st of May from Birmingham to Dubai. Our air hostess - Evie, went above and beyond for us. She was so lovely and attentive!! 10/10 service.

Emirates is an amazing airline. Just the crew service is already 5 star. Even in economy the A380 is the most amazing aircraft of the fleet. Even though I was travelling on economy. This was the best airline that I had ever flown on.

Emirates are terrible. I have flown with them for so long, business class and economy. Lately I have had the worst customer service experience and they have also stolen some money of mine because they forced me to pay twice for death selection due to their own error. When trying to speak with customer service they are rude and unhelpful. The email address I was given to send documents to is ignored. They have taken my money and have the worst service. Whay happened to you emirates? You used to be good. You have lost a once loyal customer. I will NEVER fly emirates again. To quatar it is.

I booked my flight from Toronto to Mumbai with a layover in Dubai on Feb 3, 2025. For this trip, I purchased a last-minute upgrade to Business Class for the Toronto to Dubai segment (EK242), while the Dubai to Mumbai (EK502) leg remained in Economy. My Business Class experience was excellent. The crew was attentive and helpful, assisting me throughout the journey with my 7-month-old infant. They provided a bassinet, helped with meals, and supported me when I needed to use the washroom, making the long-haul flight far more manageable. However, the Economy Class experience from Dubai to Mumbai was an absolute nightmare. Despite already enduring a long and tiring journey, the support from the Economy crew was shockingly inadequate. First, I was denied a bassinet on the grounds that my baby exceeded the height limit – a claim that was clearly inconsistent with my Business Class experience. In fact, I observed three bassinets in the front row, each occupied by mothers with babies who appeared smaller than mine, yet none of these parents were provided with the bassinet option they had booked for. Furthermore, the crew seemed indifferent to the challenges faced by a solo parent with an infant. They served food as if I could magically manage an open tray with a sleeping baby in my arms, offering no practical assistance or alternative. It was as if they had no consideration for my situation or the comfort of passengers traveling with young children. My strong recommendation: Support for passengers traveling with infants must be consistent, regardless of class. It is unacceptable for service quality to drop dramatically in Economy, especially on flights that are part of the same ticketed journey. The length of the segment is irrelevant – every passenger, especially those with young children, should receive basic support such as a bassinet and consideration when serving meals. BEWARE OF LUGGAGE SCAM. I booked a standard economy ticket and was granted 3 pieces of luggage outgoing but only 2 pieces on my return flight. I am appalled by the shocking level of negligence and lack of accountability shown by Emirates. Three weeks ago, I accidentally left a luxury Burberry gift bag onboard, worth £1500. I realized this immediately after boarding the plane and took prompt action—far beyond just sending an email. While still in Dubai, I personally went to the Emirates Lost Property Office, followed their instructions to the letter, and completed the official lost item form on-site. That was my second action, not my first. And yet, despite the urgency and clarity of my report, I have received zero meaningful communication or follow-up. Since then, I have called the Emirates Lost Property Office more than three times. Each call has ended with vague assurances and no resolution. And yes, I also followed up by email—still nothing. It’s as if Emirates expects customers to simply forget or give up. Let’s be honest: a Burberry bag valued at £1500 doesn’t just disappear. I reported this less than an hour after boarding. This isn’t about a misplacement—it’s about accountability. Someone on that aircraft or within the handling crew knows exactly what happened. The longer Emirates drags this out without transparency, the more it looks like internal theft being swept under the rug. I expected better from a flagship airline. Emirates’ complete disregard for this matter has shattered my trust. This is not the kind of service anyone should experience from a company that claims to value its customers. Unless this is urgently escalated and resolved, I will not fly Emirates again—and I’ll be sure to share this experience with others who expect integrity and professionalism when they travel. I’m an Emirates frequent flyer and I’ve enjoyed their flight experience until now. I’ll never fly emirates again.

I had discharge papers and a clean bill of health, but that was not enough for them. So I had to wake my surgeon up at 2:00 am to personally speak to them about my safe to fly status. He was in another city so he got my clinic to issue a stamped certificate. No apology, no offer to help with my lost ticket purchase. I was treated coldly and escorted out. I barely had enough US cash for rupees to get back to the hotel. Got a certificate statement from my doctor that morning and flew out at 10:30 pm that night having purchased a new ticket with Cathay Pacific, where I was treated amazingly, and my fit to fly was never brought into question. I had been told Emirates "medical team" made the assessment. However, not one member of the team spoke with me or took my vitals., and they were 100 percent wrong. I was fit enough to fly out 10 hours later, all with no sleep from the disruption they caused. They also could not care less about my loss of ticket cost (over one thousand dollars, plus 1.5 k for a new one). Horrendous treatment, zero assistance or compassion, zero offer for help with another ticket. Will never fly with this company again.

Exceptionally poor experience I encountered on a recent flight with Emirates. Unfortunately, the experience fell far short of these expectations due to a combination of equipment failure, unprofessional conduct by senior staff, and a general lack of service. 1. Malfunctioning Business Class Seat One of the business class seats was malfunctioning and would not recline, despite multiple attempts by the staff to resolve the issue. This significantly affected the comfort of the journey, and no viable solution or alternative was offered throughout the flight. 2. Unprofessional Conduct by the Purser I was particularly disappointed by the behavior of Catherine Kagwe, the Purser on the flight. Her attitude was rude, dismissive, and antagonizing when I sought assistance. When I inquired about Emirates’ global ranking as a top airline, she chose to ignore my question altogether. Shockingly, rather than addressing the malfunction issue professionally, she threatened to have the police meet me upon landing if I did not delete images of the broken seat—an unnecessary and aggressive response to a reasonable attempt to document the issue. 3. Poor Service Standards The overall service was inconsistent and inattentive. For example, I ordered a drink that was never delivered until I personally followed up 2-3 hours later. This lack of responsiveness is entirely unacceptable, particularly in a premium cabin. I must emphasize that this was the worst travel experience I have ever had, and what is most frustrating is the complete refusal to take responsibility or provide a resolution during the flight. Given the substantial cost of these tickets and the reputation Emirates holds as a leading airline, this experience was profoundly disappointing.

I used this opportunity to redeem many reward air miles accumulated over these last few years for a private, business class return trip from Germany to Sydney, Australia. The journey started with the leg from Düsseldorf to Dubai. I had originally planned to depart one day earlier so that I could get into Sydney at the beginning of the day, but Emirates unilaterally decided to cancel my original flight owing to undefined "operational reasons". Oh well. I made some necessary logistical changes for my arrival in Sydney and that was it. I arrived at the airport privately as there is no access to the excellent free limo transfer service to poor passengers redeeming airmiles. Check in was relatively trouble free and I was able to spend quality time availing myself of the facilities in the Emirates lounge. Boarding was effortless and I found my window seat easily. I took along a small box of chocolates to give to the main crew member who looked after me. She seemed to appreciate the gesture. I was greeted personally by name and settled in with a nice glass of Veuve Cliquot 2012 champagne. We actually took off 10 minutes ahead of schedule. And soon into the flight lunch was being served. I had the seared tuna as a starter with smoked salmon and avocado timbale followed by excellent spicy prawn machbous - essentially three huge prawns covered in a spicy rice. Delicious. To finish my meal, I had the three-cheese board. My request to also have fresh fruit was denied - apparently, they didn't have enough "spare" fruit"... I focused on the following wines - red - Chateau Grand Corbin 2010 (St. Emilion) and Oreno Sette Ponit (Tuscany) and white Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2021 and Jermann Pinot Grigio 2021. During the flight I made numerous forays to the back of the upper deck to sample the bar. I tried, among other things the coffee espresso as well as mugs of tea and hot chocolate. I also made extensive use of the prolific ICE entertainment system and enjoyed watching our approach into Dubai airport from the live camera on the tail wing. We actually made excellent time, arriving 27 minutes ahead of schedule. We fortunately, made it straight onto a finger at the arrivals which is significantly better than arriving at some dead-end part of the vast airport and having to be laboriously bussed into the terminals. So, there was sufficient time to transfer to the terminal where my follow-on flight would be leaving a couple of hours later. All in all, a consistently brilliant, overall experience.
